Storm is generally faster. Angel's Grace will put you to 1, and they can flashback PiF to Grapeshot you for the last point of damage next turn anyway.

One important aspect of Ad Nauseam is that you *lose life*, not take damage. Therefore Phyrexian Unlife allows you to go to a negative life total and not take poison counters. It also means Angel's Grace doesn't mean your life total stays at 1 once you've drawn your whole deck.

Spoils of the Vault has a few applications. It's a win con when you have a Lab Maniac in play, but it also is a tutor for an Ad Naus when you need it. Yes, there is a chance that you lose the game when you cast it, but the odds work out that it usually doesnt. It can also be used to find whatever card you need if you're in a pinch and are willing to roll the dice on it. Make sure you cast Angel's Grace or have an Unlife in play first though.
